## Hypothesis

What do we believe will happen?

## Baseline

What is the control configuration?

## Failure injection

What failure will be introduced?

## Treatment

What ORION capability will be evaluated?

## Metrics

What will be measured?

## Success criteria

What result would support the hypothesis?

## Reproducibility

How can another engineer repeat the experiment?
